leftEvidence.title: The curse and the one hanged on a tree

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Paul cites written statements about law, faith, curse, and hanging on a tree before naming the blessing of Abraham and the promised Spirit.
points.right: Christ’s suffering is presented with an example, no deceit, no retaliation, entrusting, sins borne in his body on the tree, wounds, healing, and return to shepherd and overseer.

points.label: Evidence boundary

payload.posture: Both passages take up execution-tree language while making different claims about curse, bearing, wounds, and resulting life.
